newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN OLO TRADE AT STANDSTILL BEFORE HOLIDAY.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN OLO TRADE AT STANDSTILL BEFORE HOLIDAY.

text.p: Trade in Belgian linear bonds came nearly to a complete standstill in the last hour of trade on Thursday before the All Saints holiday on Friday when the market is closed.
Total volume in OLO futures -- up 14 bp at 119.28 -- totalled just 375 lots, compared to more than 90,000 for the Bund future in London.
Dealers said that as they would be unable to react to Friday's U.S. jobs data, they had squared their books.
